answer: An adversary running 166 aliases as a result needs 37 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are written down in orchard, expire in karst, and trellis lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4832 identities would post 704 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
